description: Compact historical evidence archive; summaries copied from saved scores, no new sampling or diagnostic computation.
source_path_convention: Repository-relative identifiers of original artifacts; scratchpad sources need not exist in a fresh clone.

model.fit_target: Both fits include -1e-6*x drift anchor; archived model.stan and model-request.json specify the fitted target.
model.generator_caveat: The seed-5 generator omits the anchor and fixes initial x=1.5,z=0; both fits use the same anchored target with Gaussian initial-state priors. This is not a prior-predictive dataset.

strict_pass_definitions.coordinate_gate: All physical and applicable extra coordinates: finite rank R-hat <1.01, bulk/tail ESS >=400, and no frozen chain.
strict_pass_definitions.fixed_draws: Valid completion, exactly 128,000 retained draws, >=4 common draws, accounted wall <=300 s, and all-coordinate gate.
strict_pass_definitions.time: Valid time_budget_exhausted or draw_ceiling_reached termination, eight chains with >=4 common retained draws, accounted wall <=300 s, and all-coordinate gate; reaching the draw ceiling is not required.
strict_pass_definitions.regimes: Indicator diagnostics are separate evidence, not silently added to or substituted for the common-coordinate gate. Undefined constant indicators never become successful mixing evidence.

diagnostics.ess_per_second: Minimum physical bulk ESS divided by reported fit_seconds, including warmup.
diagnostics.missing_metrics: null means unavailable, including arms that retained no draws.

selection.stan_rule: Completed matched-draw Stan arm minimizing maximum rank R-hat across physical groups a,h,x,z; label breaks exact ties; no numerical-reference proximity is used.
selection.particle_rule: Fixed requested configuration mgrad-M2-N256-eight; no outcome-based particle selection.
selection.later_campaign_check: Neither completed additional fixed-draw arm improved the selected Stan maximum physical R-hat.

timing.headline: reported fit_seconds, including warmup
timing.grassmoth: Native fit duration includes initialization, JIT, warmup, sampling and native diagnostics. Action wall time includes additional orchestration and publication.
timing.stan: Driver fit duration includes Pathfinder, initialization, NUTS warmup/sampling and CSV output; selected executables were already compiled.
timing.excluded_for_both: Software installation, development/validation work and offline common scoring.
timing.clock_warning: Native GPU fit and Stan driver fit have different owners; do not present their ratio as a controlled hardware-independent speedup.
